# Nishal Interiors by Nishita

> Nishal Interiors by Nishita is a residential interior design studio based in
> Mumbai, serving Mumbai and surrounding areas. Services: residential interiors,
> modular kitchens, space planning, 3D designs and turnkey execution. Approach:
> neutral tones with modern elegance, focused on comfort, functionality and
> timeless aesthetics, from concept to completion.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nishal_interiors
